import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Bollinger Bantları için gerekli hesaplamalar
sma20 = data['Close'].rolling(window=20).mean()  # 20 günlük SMA
stddev = data['Close'].rolling(window=20).std()  # Standart sapma
bb_upper = sma20 + (stddev * 2)  # Üst Bant
bb_lower = sma20 - (stddev * 2)  # Alt Bant

# MACD için gerekli hesaplamalar
ema12 = data['Close'].ewm(span=12, adjust=False).mean()
ema26 = data['Close'].ewm(span=26, adjust=False).mean()
macd = ema12 - ema26
signal_line = macd.ewm(span=9, adjust=False).mean()
macd_histogram = macd - signal_line

# Görselleştirme
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

fig = make_subplots(rows=3, cols=1, shared_xaxes=True,
                    vertical_spacing=0.02, subplot_titles=('Bollinger Bands', 'MACD', 'ADX and Directional Indicators'))

# Bollinger Bantları Grafiği
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=data.index, y=data['Close'], name='Close', line=dict(color='blue')), row=1, col=1)
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=data.index, y=bb_upper, name='Upper BB', line=dict(color='red', dash='dot')), row=1, col=1)
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=data.index, y=sma20, name='20-day SMA', line=dict(color='green')), row=1, col=1)
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=data.index, y=bb_lower, name='Lower BB', line=dict(color='red', dash='dot')), row=1, col=1)

# MACD Grafiği
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=data.index, y=macd, name='MACD', line=dict(color='blue')), row=2, col=1)
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=data.index, y=signal_line, name='Signal Line', line=dict(color='red')), row=2, col=1)
fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=data.index, y=macd_histogram, name='Histogram', marker_color='grey'), row=2, col=1)

# ADX, +DI ve -DI Grafiği
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=data.index, y=adx, name='ADX', line=dict(color='green')), row=3, col=1)
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=data.index, y=plus_di, name='+DI', line=dict(color='blue')), row=3, col=1)
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=data.index, y=minus_di, name='-DI', line=dict(color='red')), row=3, col=1)

# Grafiğin düzenini ayarlama
fig.update_layout(height=1000, width=1000, title_text="Bollinger Bands, MACD, and ADX with DI Indicators")
fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Date", row=3, col=1)
fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Price", row=1, col=1)
fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Value", row=2, col=1)
fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Value", row=3, col=1)

# Grafiği göster
fig.show()
